> I think the problem here is that `/giveme` is not splitting the stack in two

`/giveme` isn't the only possible source of such over-sized stacks. e.g. w/ the mesecons mod, you can smelt 1 mese block into 162 mesecons. items are lost when dragging one oversized stack onto another oversized stack. i suppose one solution would be to remove the ability to set the size of a stack to a value greater than stack_max, but i'm certain people would complain about that. there's other use cases, e.g. giving a non-creative player a large quantity of nodes for some building project.

issue.body_normalized:
##### Minetest version
```
5.7.0
```

##### OS / Hardware
Operating system: linux

##### Summary
within any same inventory list that's displayed via a formspec, if you drag an over-sized (stack size greater than stack_max) stack A onto another stack B, of the same item which size is >= stack_max, but which is smaller than the size of A, the size of A will shrink to the size of B, and items will be lost.

##### Steps to reproduce
using devtest,

* `/giveme basenodes:cobble 200`
* `/giveme basenodes:cobble 100`

  ![image](https://github.com/minetest/minetest/assets/25628292/c3713082-0de4-46f2-ad3e-c3c28e019cc9)

* drag the stack of 200 onto the stack of 100
* the first stack's size will now also be 100, and 100 nodes will have been lost.

  ![image](https://github.com/minetest/minetest/assets/25628292/152eaf0b-e0fb-4b2f-9af8-685f90208d99)
